summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Natuzzi S.p.A., a foreign private issuer, announcing the timing of its unaudited first-quarter 2026 financial results and related conference call. The filing provides dial-in details, conference call logistics, and replay access information. No special situation is involved — there are no merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other corporate action disclosed. The filing is purely administrative in nature, providing shareholders and analysts with scheduling information. As such, it does not meet criteria for any special-situations category.
